purpose: Teach: 乗り込む/やって来る/得よ/上質/ニュースレター/上乗せ/不可避/初旬

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、絶対、当社、絶対、新市場に、絶対、乗り込む覚悟、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I'm counting on you. We need to dive into the new market with absolute resolve. This is serious.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding opening. Each phrase lands with weight. Measured pace. Authority without raised voice. Slight pause before the demand itself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様、本気で、絶対、当社に、絶対、やって来る、絶対、流れ、絶対、増えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Customer flow to us is increasing significantly. We're grateful for the momentum.
lines.style: Respectful formality. Careful enunciation. Steady, almost rhythmic pace. Slight bow in the voice. Confirming receipt of orders with professional earnestness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 最大限の、本気で、絶対、利益を、絶対、得ようと、絶対、努めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Push for maximum profit margins. I'm counting on you to make it happen.
lines.style: Direct and lean. Clipped syllables on the demand. Cool intensity — not angry, just fixed. No softening at the edges.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、上質な、絶対、サービス、絶対、お客様、絶対、感謝、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're committed to delivering high-quality service to every customer. Your confidence means everything to us.
lines.style: Formal acknowledgment. Warm sincerity underneath the polished phrasing. Slightly faster than before—enthusiasm breaking through protocol. Genuine gratitude in the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様への、本気で、絶対、ニュースレター、絶対、毎月、絶対、発行しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure the monthly newsletter reaches our best clients. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Direct, no-room-for-error tone. Slight edge on the requirement. Tempo picks up slightly. Assumes competence but demands attention to detail.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。価格、本気で、絶対、上乗せ、絶対、慎重に、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're proceeding carefully with any price adjustments to maintain trust and value.
lines.style: Cautious precision in the voice. Each word measured. Slower pace than the previous line. Emphasizing due diligence and thoughtfulness in execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の変化、本気で、絶対、不可避、絶対、当社、適応していけ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The industry is changing whether we like it or not. Adapt or fall behind.
lines.style: Grave, almost weary tone. Drops lower in register. Steady, unhurried—the weight of inevitability. A pause before the final clause, like watching the future arrive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来月初旬、本気で、絶対、新製品、絶対、発表予定、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We have a new product announcement scheduled for early next month.
lines.style: Crisp, professional close. Confident and forward-looking. Slightly brighter energy—a note of forward momentum. Ends cleanly without trailing off.
